notes.title: Flipper’s New Sparkle! ✨ Sign up for free HF Remaster playtests!
notes.notes: [h1]Hello Flippers![/h1][p][/p][p]We’ve decided to update you on some things that happened lately with the [b]House Flipper Remastered Collection[/b], and trust me when I say we’ve been busy![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620579/da63b174483fb5be08f765749e5d0c8d26b27e22.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Let’s move to the [i]fastest[/i] upgrade in the game! [i]What a change![/i][/p][p]That’s right! We’re in the middle of a total texture and model upgrade for House Flipper! You must admit that it shines better than a new car! Just like with the car, you can expect every object in the game to be better, sharper and [i]shinier than ever! [/i]✨ [/p][p]Speaking of Love we have plenty of new items ready for showcase from the new addition to the [b]Remastered Collection[/b]. We made sure that the new items match the original [b]House Flipper [/b]vibe but have the flair of the remastered.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620579/b03e72ac2a3dc17661310c29904b517243821263.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We wanted to make some new additions to the mechanics added in [b]Dine Out [/b]so with the new content you might expect some more tableware![/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620579/6525f3dc03c0ab3da175b5cec77925cd6e72b15a.png"][/img][/p][p]Alright, we know that all of that red can be overwhelming. We’ve got something for you rustic people. I know some of you will find a way to introduce the new furniture into your designs![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620579/fa8abf1da40d7d0ee629652675de5ebb4d4a483c.png"][/img][/p][p]Over the years, our DLCs introduced a wide range of new material variants, from sleek woods to modern finishes. Now, with the upcoming Remaster, we’re giving that same special treatment to all the classic furniture from the base game! We’re significantly expanding the number of variants and adding more item tags, making it easier than ever to bring your unique design vision to life![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620579/6a965588662a9fb2f6b88d49a74692a3786654cc.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]You might remember that we’ve mentioned that the story or at least the characters will be reimagined from the base game. Please prepare a round of applause for your clients![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620579/6e1436a4215e3e77756ab0eefeb5879b25c32a78.png"][/img][/p][p]Aside from the reimagined characters we have something new. We wanted to add a bit of ✨[i]”Wow effects"✨[/i] to the jobs to make them just a tiny bit more memorable![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620579/ce149b11b0819f1bd82b7aabbd874b183372693c.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Yes, every single Job will receive its own logo![/i][/p][p][i] [/i]Let me remind you that we[b] [/b]don't have a final price for House Flipper Remastered Collection yet, but there will definitely be a [b]discount depending on the amount of DLCs you have[/b]. The last thing we want is for you to pay again for the same thing[b].[/b][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🏯 TOKYO GAME SHOW 2025![/h3][p]Hey Flippers! If you're heading to Japan, we'd love to see you at our booth! Stop by to say hi, give us a high-five, and chat about all things House Flipper.[/p][p]Even better, you can be among the first in the world to play the [b]public demo of the House Flipper Remastered Collection[/b]! 🎮[/p][p]And for everyone else, stay tuned! We're also bringing some exciting news for House Flipper 2 players straight from Japan![/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//28210044/c41e1c9e1f7def8f39c5eed6579c492bf45028fd.png"][/img][/p][p]HALL AND STAND NUMBER: [b]General Exhibition Area, 06-C02[/b][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]✨ Sign up for free playtests![/h3][p]it's incredibly important to us that you get to experience the Remaster firsthand. To make that happen, we're excited to invite you to sign up for our upcoming playtests![/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//28210044/d6976e76819432dda93f0ee1fa72c6f16479951e.png"][/img][/p][p]We're targeting a [b]November[/b] release for playtest access, and we'll announce the specific date as soon as it's locked in. notes.title: House Flipper Remastered Collection - Early Surprise for 7th Anniversary!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Flippers![/h1]

With the 7th anniversary of the game right around the corner we’re thrilled to announce that indeed [b]House Flipper Remastered Collection is officially in the works! [/b]

[previewyoutube=0NemL9PO7nM;full][/previewyoutube]

We're bringing together everything you loved about the original game and giving it a well-deserved upgrade. Better visuals, refined features, a fresh batch of stories, and all the expansions in one toolbox. Mark your calendars – it’s set to launch this winter!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545690/ef9679d3607cb50df2a0026f1b67d3c9a2315345.gif[/img]

To kick things off, here’s a sneak peek at what’s coming: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545690/2c30f5f5ede5ea720bcb94f2ad502281da1c854c.jpg[/img]

[h3]A cozy dose of storytelling - The Heartfelt Additions [/h3]

Let’s talk about the new stuff first. The Heartfelt content introduces six fresh renovation jobs with an emotional twist. From a dreamy space for newlyweds to a place that honors someone’s love for a cup of joe - these missions offer more than just a change of wallpaper. Expect charming characters, personal stories, and a cozy vibe that sets this expansion apart. Oh - and did we mention there are [b]over 800 new items[/b]? Yeah, that too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545690/7b8c3178e7950f45bcd70ead23719520e0a01fc6.gif[/img]

[h3]A whole new shine 
[/h3]
House Flipper Remastered doesn’t just bring back the familiar gameplay – it gives it a serious visual boost. We’ve reworked the lighting, improved textures, and redesigned the interface to make every flip feel smoother and more satisfying. From cluttered apartments to freshly renovated homes, everything pops with more clarity, detail, and polish. It keeps the charm of the original, but with a fresh, modern presentation that makes every renovation more immersive than ever.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545690/548d8a25346f214f63de81e42392f36f5977d5f3.gif[/img]

[h3]Tools you’ve been waiting for and some more![/h3]

This one’s for the community - we heard your feedback and turned it into features. The Remastered Collection comes with plenty of quality-of-life upgrades, including: 

[list]
[*] A slick [b]Dark Mode[/b] for the tablet (yes, finally!)
[*] Options to [b]name[/b] and [b]export[/b] your favorite houses 
[*] A new [b]Favorites tab[/b] to quickly access your go-to items 
[*] An [b]improved Photomode[/b] for capturing your proudest flips 
[*] And more small changes that make a [b]big[/b] difference 
[/list]
It’s all about making your renovation flow as satisfying as possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545690/bf24cc3f6051a8ff6c51fe20052d492635bf9564.gif[/img]
[i]Something ya'll requested![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545690/4b7091e5e95ba5f60adcfbd43b4582e4683e1ad0.gif[/img]
[i]And something more![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545690/90e93f03387527edee86881777a60a5088d5c0c6.gif[/img]
[i]What did I named that wedding venue?[/i]

[h3]Stories with a voice [/h3]

The narrative side of House Flipper has also had a major glow-up. We’ve reworked existing missions, introduced [b]new characters[/b], and added [b]full voice acting[/b] to bring more life into each renovation job. Whether you’re meeting an old friend in a new light or getting to know someone brand new, there’s more emotion and personality in every project.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545690/7cfb354386743b07657e66c9a4643628ae5fdec4.png[/img]
[i]Some new and reimagined faces[/i]

[hr][/hr]

Whether you’re coming back after years or just starting out – [b]House Flipper Remastered[/b] is the most complete, polished, and heartfelt version of the game yet. We can’t wait to show you more soon.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3710840/House_Flipper_Remastered_Collection/
[b]We don't have a final price yet, but there will definitely be a discount depending on the amount of DLCs you have. The last thing we want is for you to pay again for the same thing.[/b]

Be sure to jump onto our social media and our Discord.

[url=https://discord.gg/frozenwayofficial][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545690/c0190de004ca8c4389d44a09a8b4354f06655868.png[/img][/url]

See you soon and happy flipping!
Cheers!
